name: Clavulanic acid
mechanism: Suicide inhibitor of class A serine beta-lactamases (TEM, SHV, CTX-M)

name: Sulbactam
mechanism: Suicide inhibitor of class A beta-lactamases

name: Tazobactam
mechanism: Suicide inhibitor of class A beta-lactamases incl. ESBLs

name: Avibactam
mechanism: Non-beta-lactam diazabicyclooctane; reversible covalent inhibitor of class A/C beta-lactamases (incl. KPC)

name: Vaborbactam
mechanism: Cyclic boronic acid; KPC (class A) inhibitor

name: Durlobactam
mechanism: Diazabicyclooctane; broad class A/C/D inhibitor (paired with sulbactam)

name: Amikacin
mechanism: 30S ribosomal subunit inhibitor; resists many modifying enzymes

name: Vancomycin
mechanism: Binds D-Ala-D-Ala termini; blocks cell-wall synthesis

name: Pretomanid
mechanism: NO donor; mycolic-acid and respiratory inhibition

name: PA beta-naphthylamide
mechanism: Peptidomimetic RND efflux inhibitor (PA beta N) that resensitizes multidrug-resistant strains

name: CCCP
mechanism: Protonophore; collapses proton-motive force driving RND efflux (research tool)

name: Verapamil
mechanism: Calcium-channel blocker repurposed as bacterial efflux adjuvant

name: Reserpine
mechanism: Alkaloid that inhibits bacterial efflux pumps

name: Ciclopirox
mechanism: Metal chelator; reported NDM-1 metallo-beta-lactamase inhibitor

name: Captopril
mechanism: Thiol ACE inhibitor; prototype NDM-1 thiol inhibitor

name: Aspergillomarasmine A
mechanism: Natural fungal chelator; removes Zn2+ and restores carbapenem activity against NDM-1
